articles.summary: When considering cutting down or quitting drinking completely, it's normal to wonder what happens next. Though the specifics vary from person to person, we can talk about some recognized trends so that you know what to expect.‍

articles.summary: If you've been drinking alcohol on a regular basis for a long time, you might hear that it's dangerous or difficult to quit cold-turkey. A tapering process can help you to change your relationship with alcohol in a safe, sustainable way.
articles.title: How to Taper Off Alcohol

articles.summary: Maybe you're already on the path to quitting or cutting down on alcohol use, or maybe you're still considering it. Either way, it's important to know some ways that you can stay on the path once you're on it.‍
articles.title: Tips to Stay Sober

articles.summary: Ditch the booze, shed the pounds! Learn how quitting alcohol can lead to rapid weight loss and discover actionable tips to support your journey. Start now!
articles.title: How Soon After Quitting Alcohol Will I Lose Weight?

articles.summary: If you've landed on this page, you're probably in a place where you're considering cutting alcohol out of your life, and you want it to be a quick, clean break. You can make this decision today.

articles.summary: Unfortunately, our societal understanding of a “drinking problem” is very polarized. In the eyes of society, you either have a drinking problem...or you don’t. However, the societal acceptance of alcohol has blurred the line between what it means to drink responsibly and drink recklessly...
articles.title: Sobriety as a Spectrum

articles.summary: Alcohol changes your brain on a biological level. Over time, drinking can wear down the mental and emotional resilience needed to change your habits. This can become like a feedback loop, keeping you stuck in cycles of drinking. Fortunately, there are ways to break out of this and take back your power.
articles.title: How Drinking is Robbing Your Power (And How to Take it Back)

articles.summary: Have you ever participated in 'Dry January' before? If you haven't heard of it, it's a public health campaign where people all around the United States and Europe decide to abstain from alcohol for the month. Some think of it as a New Years Resolution, for others it's a yearly tradition.
articles.title: 5 Reasons to Participate in Dry January
